name: golang-development
description: Focused Go development skills for building and auditing Go projects across planning, architecture, idioms, testing, linting, release, and deployment.

interface.longDescription: A compact skill pack for agents building or auditing Go applications, organized by workflow routing, code audits, planning, architecture, implementation idioms, testing, quality, and build/deploy readiness.
defaultPrompt: Use $golang-development-workflow to plan and implement this Go change within the requested scope.
Use $golang-code-audit to audit this Go repository and report concrete findings without editing files.
Use $golang-code-audit to review this Go diff for correctness and regressions without editing files.
